issues.issue: The parties clause names only six parties and omits the Certificate Insurer, yet Article XII and Section 11.12 confer extensive consent, control and payment rights on a Certificate Insurer. Whether the insurer is a party bound by, or merely a beneficiary of, the Agreement must be worked out from the two together.

This preliminary recital states the Trust Fund 'is hereby conveyed to the Trustee,' while the operative conveyance in Section 2.01 makes the transfer subject to delivery of the Mortgage Files and other conditions. A party could argue the recital effects or controls the conveyance notwithstanding Section 2.01.

The direction that 'any inconsistencies or ambiguities in this Agreement' be resolved to preserve the REMIC elections is a general interpretive override whose reach can only be fixed against the rest of the instrument, including the distribution priorities of Section 4.02 and the amendment limits of Section 11.01. It is unclear whether it subordinates express operative terms to tax-driven construction.

Clause (iv) reads 'until the principal balance of such Subsidiary REMIC Regular Interest the Subordinated Portion for Loan Group 3,' omitting the verb 'equals' that appears in every parallel clause. The omission leaves the Group 3 priority without a stated stopping point.

Clause (iv) omits the verb 'equals' ('until the principal balance of such Middle REMIC 1 Regular Interest the Subordinated Portion for Loan Group 3'), unlike the parallel clauses (i)-(v). The Group 3 priority therefore has no stated limit on its face.

This paragraph says the Master REMIC issues a 'Class R-IV Interest' as its sole residual class, but the Preliminary Statement paragraph on certificate interests states that the Class R Certificate represents ownership of the sole residual interest in the Master REMIC. Which instrument evidences the Master REMIC residual cannot be answered from one of the two alone.

The Class X-2 Notional Amount is written '$452,182,00', which is not a well-formed figure and is one digit short of the $452,182,000 implied by the Group 2 balances. The typographical error leaves the initial notional amount uncertain on the face of the provision.

The notional component is defined by reference to 'the aggregate of the Class Principal Amounts of the Middle REMIC 2 Regular Interests,' a term the Agreement does not define (it defines 'Class Principal Balance'). The measure of the Class C notional balance is therefore uncertain.
